guitar.notes: Accurate: Corgan known for Stratocaster and later Reverend signature; Iha used Les Paul/various.

tone.target: dry heavy fuzz crunch with octave-like bite
tone.profile: dry heavy fuzz crunch with octave-like bite
tone.summary: Fuzz -> Compression -> Boost/OD -> Amp (UK 800) -> Cab (4x12) -> EQ -> Delay/Room.

rig.name: Smashing Pumpkins - Bullet With Butterfly Wings - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Achieve compressed sustain and tight palm-muted chug.
Provide the thick fuzz drive (Big Muff style).
Add extra bite and upper mids for the aggressive tone.
blocks.gap: Using Boost as a final drive stage to push the amp into saturation, enhancing the fuzz's aggression.

blocks.purpose: Provide a high-gain, aggressive British rock tone suitable for the era.
Simulate the required Marshall/SS power amp and 4x12 cab.
Enhance the bright upper mids and overall thickness of the fuzz tone.
Add the required dry room ambience without sounding wet or shimmering.
Optional delay for added depth (kept inactive per 'avoid' list).
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids chorus/delay, so this is kept off but included as a potential module.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the default IR for a more aggressive, vintage 4x12 model.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, vintage Marshall sound required for the fuzz tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased punch and grit in the upper mids.
